problem: For which values of $k$ does the series ${\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{(\frac{64}{{2}^{k}})}^{n}$ converge?
worked_solution:
We see that this is a geometric series with a common ratio of $r=\frac{64}{{2}^{k}}.$ 

For the series to converge, we require $|r|<1.$ Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}|\frac{64}{{2}^{k}}| & <1 \\ \frac{64}{{2}^{k}} & <1 \\ 64 & <{2}^{k} \\ {2}^{k} & >64.\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that we could remove the absolute value bars because $\frac{64}{{2}^{k}}$ is always positive.

The equation ${2}^{k}=64$ has the solution $k=6.$ Now, since ${2}^{k}$ increases as $k$ increases, the solution to ${2}^{k}>64$ must be $k>6.$
